name: Mitouge Otoha
source:
The SNS manager of Melonchu.

A mysterious character who sprinkles his conversations with Japanese internet memes from both the Heisei and Reiwa eras. While he usually has low energy, he’s an aggressive younger boy who’s very proactive toward you, the manager.

The "Otoha-world" will be in full swing in the "Romance Route Expansion"!

[Edited from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/4067070?emclan=103582791475364566&emgid=505099815104808811]Steam[/url]]
